# Frozen inputs at a fiscal year end

A page re-assembled between a 10-K and the next 10-Q has two shapes no other moment has. The 10-K
tags its weighted-average share counts over the YEAR and no fourth quarter. And the CIQ annual
table has no LTM column, because the year just closed is CIQ's latest period. The pins here hold one
real name in that state. They track NO page and are never regenerated by
`scripts/build_companyfacts_fixture.py`.

| file | what it is | cut | pinned by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SMPL.companyfacts.json` | The Simply Good Foods Company (CIK 1702744) companyfacts, the share-count tags only (`EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding`, `CommonStockSharesOutstanding`, `CommonStockSharesIssued`, the basic and diluted weighted averages) | From the SEC cache fetched 2026-10-28, which carries the FY2026 10-K 0001702744-26-000031 (filed 2026-10-27). Cut through `build_companyfacts_fixture.subset`, unmodified apart from the tag subset, `sort_keys`, `indent=1`. | `tests/test_dilution_denominator.py`: the latest end, 2026-08-29, carries only the 363-day year (92,372,473), and the last 10-Q quarter 2026-03-01..2026-05-30 (89,940,680) is the figure read |
| `SMPL.page.json` | SMPL's page from the 2026-10-28 re-assembly (run `6a57e81b`, reference date 2026-10-16), cut to `ticker`, `assembled_at`, `reference_date`, `caveats` and `mechanical.{financial_summary, stock_info, valuation.pe}` | The page as that run wrote it, before this fix: assembled on the old code, so its anchor reads the year and its caveats carry no (d) P/E caveat | `tests/test_dilution_denominator.py` (the anchor's share inputs through `compute_anchor`); `tests/test_pe_basis_cause_claim.py`: the annual table runs FY17 … FY26, FY27E, FY28E with no LTM column, FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS is −1.69, and the EDGAR P/E is 9.56x |

**Checked at cut time (2026-10-29):**
- The companyfacts subset serves the same `_latest_point` / `_traded_unit_counts` results as the full blob.
- CIQ's P/LTM EPS in the same export reads NM at the 2026-10-27 close (`ciq_sheets.pe_ltm_current`), so production shows the EDGAR multiple alone. That is why the P/E pin passes no CIQ multiple.
